findings.detail: R1: Arbitrary inner spans discard outer attribution/modality before automatic acceptance. With a current eligible source `I think I like apricots`, model output content/quote `I like apricots`, start=8,end=23,category=FACT,sensitivity=NORMAL,statementKind=EXPLICIT_STATEMENT passes supports() at lines10-16; statementKind() lines5-7 inspects only quote, so MemoryAcceptance.records automatically APPROVES it as an explicit statement at confidence90. The same path accepts the unsupported counterfactual `I lived in Paris` at [7,23) from `I wish I lived in Paris`, and indirect `I live in Boston` at [19,35) from `My friend believes I live in Boston`. GemmaMemoryExtractor.decode delegates to these predicates and the transactional finish repeats the same insufficient check. Static source-regex/predicate translation with ASCII examples confirms acceptance; no real-model/Kotlin execution is claimed. Require complete supported clause/source attribution with outer uncertainty, negation, quotation and hypothetical context preserved or reject fail-closed; merely changing model instructions or enumerating these few words is insufficient. Add additive regressions for inner-span qualifier removal without altering frozen tests.

R2: The voice onPromptSubmitted callback at line840 calls comparison?.log("prompt audioBytes=... text=$submitted") before the sensitiveVoiceReply guard at843. An opt-in Moonshine live-comparison turn asking `What is my diagnosis?`, while unlocked with an accepted RESTRICTED `My diagnosis is asthma` memory, still takes ConversationRuntime NORMAL_CHAT and freshMemoryTurnContext/onMemoryBound. The nonnull voiceAudio call preserves this callback, and the generated voice prompt contains the sensitive packet. Frozen LiveComparison.Trial.log retains its first1500 characters; the actual VoiceResponsePolicy/prompt layout puts asthma at offset1017 in the static construction probe, within that retained prefix. Trial.finish retains the logs in global results after lock; report()/writeZip and the deferred export callback have no live disclosure fence. Masking comparison answer and skipping DiagnosticRecorder does not remove this raw memory-derived prompt copy. Suppress/sanitize sensitive-bound comparison prompt logging at the allowed Runtime boundary (and audit other comparison output callbacks), or exclude memory context from comparison turns; do not modify frozen LiveComparison/test files. This is a deterministic source-path/copy defect, not a semantic-classifier or physical-device qualification gap.
